name: io.github.Blue-B/sidehand
title: Sidehand
description: Let AI agents operate Windows apps behind your window, without taking your mouse or keyboard.

environmentVariables.name: SIDEHAND_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Only these windows can be read, operated or captured, e.g. Notepad;Contoso* (title parts or wildcards, separated by ;). Screen captures, launching apps and the clipboard are then off.

environmentVariables.name: SIDEHAND_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: When the client cannot ask the user (no MCP elicitation): unset acts without asking, strict refuses first actions on an app and sensitive actions (Delete, Send, Pay, window close) and tells the agent to ask the user, off never asks.
